{"inserts":["INSERT INTO public.users (id, email, name, country, status, created_at) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 'u1@example.com', NULL, 'US', 'active', '2020-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz), (2, 'u2@example.com', 'Bob', 'DE', 'active', '2020-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz)","INSERT INTO public.products (id, sku, name, category, price_cents) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 'SKU-1', 'Alpha', $1, 100), (2, 'SKU-2', 'Beta', upper($1), 200), (3, 'SKU-3', 'Gamma', $1, 300), (4, 'SKU-4', 'Delta', $1, 400), (5, 'SKU-5', 'Epsilon', lower($1), 500), (6, 'SKU-6', 'Zeta', 'zz-other-category', 600)","INSERT INTO public.orders (id, user_id, status, total_cents, created_at, updated_at) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 1, 'paid', 1000, $3, $3), (2, 1, 'paid', 1000, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamptz), (3, 2, 'pending', 1000, 'infinity'::timestamptz, 'infinity'::timestamptz), (4, 2, 'cancelled', 0, '-infinity'::timestamptz, '-infinity'::timestamptz)","INSERT INTO public.line_items (id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_cents) OVERRIDING SYSTEM VALUE VALUES (1, 1, 1, $4, 100), (2, 1, 1, $4, 100), (3, 3, 1, $4 + 1, 100), (4, 1, 4, $4 - 1, 400), (5, 2, 4, $4, 400), (6, 4, 4, $4 + 1, 400), (7, 3, 2, $4 + 1, 200), (8, 1, 5, $4, 500), (9, 1, 6, $4, 600), (10, 3, 3, $4 - 1, 300)"]}
